projects.name: bash-me-up
projects.description: The portfolio you are looking at: a monochrome CRT terminal with real barrel distortion, built with React and TypeScript.
highlights: Real barrel distortion through an SVG displacement map: no canvas, no WebGL, the text stays selectable.
Commands are pure functions that return data, so the whole shell is unit-tested without a DOM.
All content comes from one JSON file and is type-checked at build time.
Linted, tested and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions on every push.
